name: PromoForge Smart Campaigns for WooCommerce
author: Hiren Gediya

sections.description:
PromoForge Smart Campaigns for WooCommerce is a powerful and flexible promotional plugin that helps store owners create advanced offer campaigns inside WooCommerce.

Create Flash Sales, Scheduled Offers, Special URL-Based Offers, and BOGO (Buy One Get One & Buy X Get Y) promotions with full control over products, categories, discount logic, and visibility.

Designed for performance and real-world WooCommerce use cases, PromoForge ensures discounts are applied correctly on the product page, cart, and checkout — without affecting global pricing rules.

Key Features

• Flash Offers with countdown timer support
• Upcoming Offers with scheduled start and end dates
• Special Offers displayed via shortcode
• BOGO Offers (Buy One Get One / Buy X Get Y with discount)
• Category-based or product-based targeting
• Discount logic applied on:
– Product page
– Cart page
– Checkout page
• Offer-specific pricing logic (not global discounts)
• AJAX-powered admin interface
• Shortcode support for custom placement
• Secure, sanitized, and optimized codebase
• Fully compatible with WooCommerce

Offer Types

Flash Offers

Create limited-time promotions with automatic expiration and countdown-based logic.

Upcoming Offers

Schedule campaigns to automatically activate at a future date and time.

Special Offers

Create exclusive URL-based offers and display them using shortcodes. Discounts apply only when accessed through the specific offer link.

BOGO Offers

Create Buy One Get One or Buy X Get Y campaigns with quantity-based rules. Discounts are applied automatically in the cart and checkout.

How It Works

  1. Create an offer from the WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Select the offer type (Flash, Upcoming, Special, or BOGO).
  3. Choose products or categories.
  4. Define discount rules.
  5. The offer applies automatically based on configured conditions.

PromoForge Smart Campaigns for WooCommerce is ideal for store owners who want structured promotional campaigns instead of simple global discounts.

Perfect For

  1. WooCommerce store owners running flash sales
  2. Stores offering BOGO promotions
  3. Marketing campaigns with limited-time discounts
  4. Seasonal or scheduled promotional events
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/promoforge-smart-campaigns-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Offers’ menu in the dashboard to manage offers and settings.

Compatibility

  1. WordPress 5.8+
  2. WooCommerce 7.0+
  3. PHP 7.4+
  4. Supports variable and simple products
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes, it supports variable products and also supports single products.
